sloka: अन्न कूटाः च दृश्यन्ते बहवः पर्वत उपमाः ।दिवसे दिवसे तत्र सिद्धस्य विधिवत् तदा ॥१-१४-१५॥
transliteration: anna kūṭāḥ ca dṛśyante bahavaḥ parvata upamāḥ ।divase divase tatra siddhasya vidhivat tadā ॥1-14-15॥

translations.english: Brahmins having tasted the delicious food cooked in prescribed manner, praised saying "Ah We are fully satisfied. Prosperity to you". Such were the words heard by king Dasaratha.
